Read in data

```{r}
diet = read.table("diet.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```

Problem 1a

```{r}
exercise = ifelse(diet$method == "exercise", 1, 0)
both = ifelse(diet$method == "both", 1,0)
full_model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exercise + both + calories*method, data = diet)
reduced_model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exercise + both, data = diet)
anova(full_model)
anova(reduced_model)
```

Problem 1c

```{r}
full_model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exercise + both, data = diet)
reduced_model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories, data = diet)
anova(full_model)
anova(reduced_model)
summary(full_model)
```
